newsitem.title: USA: TurboChef in Kenny Rogers alliance with HFS.
newsitem.headline: TurboChef in Kenny Rogers alliance with HFS.

text.p: TurboChef Inc said on Thursday it had formed a strategic alliance with HFS Inc and Kenny Rogers Roasters to offer a new quick-order food service in HFS's franchised hotels.
TurboChef said it plans to offer room service meals within 15 minutes, and counter service meals within three minutes through Kenny Rogers Roasters Express.
Operational testing of each of the Kenny Rogers Roasters Express concepts will begin in May at a number of HFS Hospitality brand hotels, TurboChef said.
TurboChef is a foodservice technology company that designs, develops and markets high speed cooking systems.
HFS Inc franchises hotels including Days Inn, Ramada, and Travelodge, with more than 500,000 rooms worldwide.
Roasters Corp is a member company of the Berjaya Group, a Malaysian-based company that operates the Kenny Rogers Roasters name.
